conditions: Method and resource estimates for spin-free U(1)×SU(2)-symmetric electronic Hamiltonians; not physical QPU execution.
Benchmarks are singlet CAS(30e,20o) [Fe2S2]2− and CAS(54e,36o) [Fe4S4]2−; maximum spin-adapted bond dimension 1000 multiplets.
Same untruncated states: dense baselines require 51×/135× and U(1)×U(1) baselines 3.4×/4.9× the Toffoli count.
Matched truncation fidelity: dense ratios approximately 37–38×/91–95× and U(1)×U(1) ratios 3.5–3.6×/5.0–5.4×; ratios use log-space interpolation and χ125,250,500 points.
Truncation fidelity is relative to the untruncated χ1000 DMRG MPS, not the exact ground state. QPE ground-state success continues to depend on true ground-state overlap.

15-bit rotations; QROAM lookups minimize Toffoli count with no ancilla cap for every comparator. Dense protocol is costed as published without the real-tensor saving included in the U(1)×U(1) baseline.
Table2 ancillary qubits: Fe2S2 dense516/U1 514/new267; Fe4S4 dense997/U1 996/new268. Up to3.7× fewer ancillas is distinct from physical qubits or total runtime.
Fe4S4 DMRG stopped without meeting energy-convergence criterion; no exact ground-state overlap or full QPE success probability is established by Table2/Figure5.
Authors acknowledge independent similar reduced-tensor preparation preprint arXiv:2611.19728; avoid unsupported first/unique claims.
